limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the shift but asserted match one clock earlier than the original registered comparisons and changed the shift register’s reset value from zeros to ones.
The test checked the just-shifted window and required nine post-reset samples, encoding the rewrite’s assumptions rather than checking the original cycle timing and zero-filled startup behavior.
